process_checkpoint: process a PyTorch checkpoint file to remove unnecessary keys and save a smaller published version with SHA256 hash
parse_args: parse command-line arguments for input checkpoint file, output file, and optional save-keys to filter checkpoint contents
publish_model_cli: run the publish_model CLI to convert a training checkpoint into a compact published model with a SHA256-based filename
filter_checkpoint_keys: filter a PyTorch checkpoint to keep only specified keys like meta and state_dict for reduced file size
add_hash_to_model: compute SHA256 hash of a saved checkpoint and append the first 8 characters to the output filename
